name: optimum-benchmarks-ci
description: A collection of automated benchmarks used in continuous integration for Hugging Face Optimum that measure model correctness and runtime behavior across hardware backends and optimization passes. It is designed to detect regressions in inference results, performance (latency/throughput), and memory usage when changes are introduced to the codebase. Intended primarily for CI validation rather than academic model comparison.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by model and hardware; no single aggregated SOTA
reputation: Primarily used within the Optimum / Hugging Face developer community as CI benchmarks; modest external adoption.
